newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks lose steam on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks lose steam on profit-taking.

text.p: Manila stocks fell back by midtrade on Monday as investors cashed-in gains made early in the session and last week, traders said.
"Investors are taking profits after the big news (de facto devaluation of the peso) on Friday," said Raymond Garcia, analyst at Diversified Securities.
The composite index dropped to negative territory to 2,697.04, down 4.10 points or 0.15 percent from Friday's close.
The index had touched a high of 2,747.93 in early trade.
The index had soared by 189.99 points, or 7.57 percent, to 2,701.14 points on Friday after the announcement of the Central Bank that it would allow the peso to trade in a wider band.
"After Friday's fantastic run, calm is finally reigning in both the equities and foreign exchange markets," Garcia said.
Some 1.079 billion pesos worth of shares changed hands after one hour of trade.
Among the issues that yielded to profit taking included Solid Group, down 50 centavos or by 10.31 percent to 4.35 pesos. -- DOLLY AGLAY (63 2) 841-8936, Fax 817-6267
